value.rationale: The object is the natural orbit classification of every three-center quadratic-residue cover, a canonical refinement beyond merely determining the minimum covering number. The result is complete for all odd finite fields, exhibits multiple inequivalent minimizing configurations at q=7,9,13, and gives exact stabilizer-size distinctions. The restriction to small fields is forced by a mathematical Hasse cutoff, not an arbitrary truncation; prior q25/original domination numbers are credited.
